country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_UAE_1970_contracts.1001
	title = COLDWAR_UAE_1970_contracts.1001.t
	desc = COLDWAR_UAE_1970_contracts.1001.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_UAE_1970_contracts.1001.0
		ai_chance = { base = 5 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_received_protection
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_protection = 1 }
			country_exists = UAE
			UAE = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_protection has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_protection check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_protection = 1 } check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_partner_protection value = ROOT.id compare = equals } tag = UAE
			always = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_renew_protection
			COLDWAR_UAE_british_subject_live = yes
			COLDWAR_UAE_before_current_release_due = yes
			NOT = { has_war_with = ENG } }
			NOT = { has_war_with = UAE }
			UAE = { check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_treaty_context_protection value = UAE.COLDWAR_UAE_treaty_nonce compare = equals } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_received_protection
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_protection = 1 }
				country_exists = UAE

				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_renew_protection
				COLDWAR_UAE_british_subject_live = yes
				COLDWAR_UAE_before_current_release_due = yes
				NOT = { has_war_with = ENG } }
				NOT = { has_war_with = UAE }
				UAE = { check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_treaty_context_protection value = UAE.COLDWAR_UAE_treaty_nonce compare = equals } }
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_received_protection
			UAE = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_protection clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_protection }

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_UAE_1970_contracts.70001
	title = COLDWAR_UAE_1970_contracts.70001.t
	desc = COLDWAR_UAE_1970_contracts.70001.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_UAE_1970_contracts.70001.0
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		trigger = {
			tag = UAE
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_protection
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_protection = 1 }
			tag = UAE
			always = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_renew_protection
			COLDWAR_UAE_british_subject_live = yes
			COLDWAR_UAE_before_current_release_due = yes
			NOT = { has_war_with = ENG }
			check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_treaty_context_protection value = COLDWAR_UAE_treaty_nonce compare = equals }
			ENG = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_received_protection has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_friendship_counter_quoted check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_protection = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				tag = UAE
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_protection
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_protection = 1 }
				tag = UAE
				always = yes
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_renew_protection
				COLDWAR_UAE_british_subject_live = yes
				COLDWAR_UAE_before_current_release_due = yes
				NOT = { has_war_with = ENG }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_treaty_context_protection value = COLDWAR_UAE_treaty_nonce compare = equals }
				ENG = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_received_protection has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_friendship_counter_quoted check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_protection = 1 } }
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_protection
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_protection
			ENG = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_received_protection clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_friendship_counter_quoted }
			COLDWAR_UAE_accept_immediate_release = yes
			if = { limit = { is_subject = no } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_friendship_accepted COLDWAR_UAE_sync_treaty_spirits = yes COLDWAR_UAE_refresh_programmes = yes }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_UAE_1970_contracts.70001.1
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_protection
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_protection = 1 }
			}
			COLDWAR_UAE_close_protection_offer = yes
		}
	}
}
